test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the expenditure of a family in percentage during a certain year. If the total amount spent during the year is Rs. 3,00,000. On which of the following items, amount spent together is equal to Rs. 1,50,000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2960ea315fbb2a2d43321a0a9bad4189877944f048f07570b1194b28f9b059df.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Total amount spent during the year is Rs. 3,00,000.

Amount spent together on some items is equal to Rs. 1,50,000.

**Calculation:**

150000/300000 × 100 = 50%

Now, take options

Option 1) Education, Others, Savings = 25% + 15% + 20% = 60% ≠ 50%

Option 2) Transport, Others, Education = 10% + 15% + 25% = 50%

Option 3) Savings, Housing, Education = 20% + 10% + 25% = 55% ≠ 50%

Option 4) Savings, Clothing, Education = 20% + 10% + 25% = 55% ≠ 50%

**So, only Option 2) is correct.**
